description: This is a Python source file implementing a Configuration and Feature Toggle Service for a web application backend, managing application settings, feature flags, and runtime configurations.

classes.name: ConfigService
classes.description: Service class for configuration and feature toggle management, providing methods to create, read, update, delete, and retrieve runtime configurations and feature toggles.

methods.name: Optional[Configuration] get_configuration(self, key: str, include_sensitive: bool = False)
methods.description: Retrieve a configuration by key, optionally including sensitive configurations.

methods.name: Tuple[List[Configuration],int] get_configurations( self, category: Optional[str] = None, include_sensitive: bool = False, include_system: bool = True, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100 )
methods.description: Retrieve multiple configurations with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: Configuration create_configuration(self, config_data: ConfigCreate, admin_id: int)
Optional[Configuration] update_configuration( self, key: str, config_data: ConfigUpdate, admin_id: int, allow_system: bool = False )
methods.description: Update an existing configuration identified by key.

methods.name: bool delete_configuration(self, key: str, allow_system: bool = False)
methods.description: Soft delete a configuration by key.

methods.name: Optional[FeatureToggle] get_feature_toggle(self, name: str)
methods.description: Retrieve a feature toggle by name.

methods.name: Tuple[List[FeatureToggle],int] get_feature_toggles( self, environment: Optional[str] = None, enabled_only: bool = False, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100 )
methods.description: Retrieve multiple feature toggles with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: FeatureToggle create_feature_toggle(self, toggle_data: FeatureToggleCreate, admin_id: int)
Optional[FeatureToggle] update_feature_toggle( self, name: str, toggle_data: FeatureToggleUpdate, admin_id: int )
bool delete_feature_toggle(self, name: str)
methods.description: Soft delete a feature toggle by name.

methods.name: RuntimeConfigResponse get_runtime_config( self, environment: str = "all", include_sensitive: bool = False )
methods.description: Retrieve runtime configuration including settings and feature toggles for a given environment.

methods.name: bool is_feature_enabled( self, feature_name: str, user_id: Optional[str] = None, user_groups: Optional[List[str]] = None, environment: str = "all" )
methods.description: Check if a feature toggle is enabled for a specific user/context and environment.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] bulk_update_configs( self, updates: List[Dict[str, Any]], admin_id: int )
methods.description: Perform bulk updates on multiple configuration entries.
